summary: Crash when changing render distance / java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 28084 out of bounds for length 26136
description: When changing render/view distance via the option menu while standing inside a world, minecraft sometimes crashes with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. This can be best reproduced by spam-clicking the slider in random positions, although for me it crashed after only one click, the first time.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Singleplayer world with default settings.
3. Open Options and navigate to Video Settings.
4. Change the Render Distance slider to a random position and immediately click again in a different random position.
5. Observe that the game crashes with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Observed Behavior: When changing the render distance in Minecraft through the options menu while inside a world, the game may crash due to an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, specifically indicating that the index 28084 is out of bounds for a length of 26136. This issue can be consistently reproduced by rapidly clicking the render distance slider in various positions, although in some instances, the crash occurs after only a single click. The crash appears to be related to the way the game processes changes in render distance, which may lead to an attempt to access an invalid index in the underlying data structure. This behavior can be observed in both single-player and multiplayer modes, and it is critical for developers to understand the specific conditions under which the crash occurs to facilitate effective troubleshooting and resolution.
Expected Behavior: When changing the render/view distance via the options menu while standing inside a world, Minecraft should adjust the render distance smoothly without crashing. The application should handle the input from the slider correctly, allowing the player to modify the distance multiple times without encountering an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The game should maintain stability and performance throughout the adjustment process, ensuring a seamless experience.
